parameters: The Bloodrose crypt. The names on the lintel go back further than the kingdom does.
The door is sealed - not with a lock, but with something colder.
Its leaves are the colour of wine held up to a candle.
Petals drift down, though there is no wind.
A horned figure pours black water into the basin.
The water is ice-cold and perfectly still.
"VILLA BLOODROSE."
Below, newer letters: "The house receives no one."
"Here sleeps Aurelie Bloodrose, who loved the garden more than the house."
The name has been scratched out. Fresh roses lie on it anyway.
"To the first David, who swore the oath and kept it."
